messages:
anya: quick note from today's onboarding run: a few users saw short 429 spikes. Console quota steady, looks client-side.
tom: can you paste the quickstart client snippet?
anya: trimmed: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxInflightRequests: 12,
  paginationPrefetch: 2,
  pageSize: 40
});
```
harpreet: 12 inflight + 2 prefetch can create brief bursts per-session. small accounts with low token QPS will see 429s.
lisa: parity callout: python quickstart defaults to max_inflight=5. we accidentally shipped more aggressive JS defaults.
tom: short-term: change quickstart to safer defaults (maxInflightRequests: 6, paginationPrefetch: 0) and add a tiny leaky-bucket wrapper in the sample repo.
anya: i'll patch the sample and add a troubleshooting blurb: "If you see onboarding 429s, reduce maxInflightRequests/paginationPrefetch, enable jittered backoff, check Console quota."
sdk-bot: created issue #1432: "quickstart: smooth js defaults + add inflight telemetry"
ops-bot: note: support can temporarily increase burst allowance but prefer fixing defaults to avoid tail cost.
